name: zclass_sound_update_playback
description: zClass_Sound::UpdatePlayback gates active sound nodes, marks dirty 3D playback when needed, recomputes world position, starts or updates playback handles, and clears the pending update bit.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zClass sound update helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass sound/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x452dc0 validates null-node/data error returns, inactive-node early return, dirty-3D marking for root runtime flag bit 1 or non-root nodes, ComputeWorldTransform dispatch, existing-handle Update3DDispatch path, sample PlayA3D/PlayA3DSimple paths with zSndPlayHandle_TryEnableManaged, managed flag bit 3 set when enable succeeds, pending bit clear, and zero return.

The native sound smoke verifies inactive early return, dirty runtime flag promotion, ComputeWorldTransform/world position update, pending-bit clear, no-sample paths, and null-node/data error returns. Audio playback branches are covered by accepted zSnd sample/play-handle functional targets.
